study type: Mixed methods study incorporating qualitative interviews and data extraction from published randomised controlled trials (RCTs)
exposure: practical management of primary surgical wounds
outcome: development of outcome measures for surgical wound management and patient experience
cohort: The participants included 64 patients and 15 healthcare professionals from abdominal general surgical specialities and obstetrics (caesarean section).
finding: The study successfully developed two distinct outcome measures: one for healthcare professionals focusing on wound management (exudate and allergic reactions) and another for patients addressing their experience of wounds (comfort, dressing removal, protection, impact on daily activities, ease of movement, anxiety, and satisfaction).
